name: attendance
definition: 一种信息记录,记录某个成员参与某场活动的关联事实,以成员标识与活动标识为连接键。 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:成员是参与活动的人这一实体,参与记录只是成员与活动之间的关联信息。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attendance; provenance: direct source attendance

name: budget
definition: 一种信息记录,针对某场活动按类别设定的经费额度,含预算金额、已支出与剩余金额。 Counterexample: 易与支出(expense)混淆:预算是事先设定的额度,支出是实际发生的费用。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table budget; provenance: direct source budget

name: event
definition: 在特定日期与地点发生、具有名称、类型与状态的一次组织性活动。 Counterexample: 易与预算(budget)混淆:活动是发生的事件,预算是为该事件编制的经费计划。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table event; provenance: direct source event

name: expense
definition: 一种信息记录,记录某成员在某日期发生的一笔费用及其金额与审批状态,并归属到相应预算。 Counterexample: 易与预算(budget)混淆:支出是实际发生的费用记录,预算是事先设定的额度。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table expense; provenance: direct source expense

name: income
definition: 一种信息记录,记录某成员在某日期收到的一笔款项及其来源与金额。 Counterexample: 易与支出(expense)混淆:收入是资金流入记录,支出是资金流出记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table income; provenance: direct source income

name: major
definition: 高等学校中按学科门类划分的培养方向,隶属于某院系与学院。 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:专业是培养方向这一分类信息,成员是就读于该专业的人。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table major; provenance: direct source major

name: member
definition: 加入该组织并具有姓名、联系方式、职位等属性的自然人。 Counterexample: 易与专业(major)混淆:成员是自然人,专业是其所归属的培养方向。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table member; provenance: direct source member

name: zip_code
definition: 一种信息记录,以邮政编码标识某地理区域,并给出该区域所属城市、县、州等信息。 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:邮政编码是地理区域编码信息,成员是自然人。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table zip_code; provenance: direct source zip_code

name: EventStatus
definition: The current status of an event (e.g., Open, Closed, Planning).

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: A textual description of what an expense was for.

name: ExpenseDate
definition: The date on which an expense was incurred.

name: ExpenseCost
definition: The monetary cost of an individual expense.

name: ExpenseApproved
definition: Whether an expense has been approved.

name: MemberPosition
definition: The role or position a member holds in the club.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: The t-shirt size of a member.

name: MemberFirstName
definition: The first name of a member.

name: MemberLastName
definition: The last name of a member.

name: MemberPhone
definition: The phone number of a member.

name: MemberZip
definition: The zip code of a member's address.

name: MajorName
definition: The name of the academic major.

name: MajorDepartment
definition: The department offering the major.

name: MajorCollege
definition: The college offering the major.

name: EventName
definition: The name of an event.

name: EventType
definition: The type/category of an event.

name: EventDate
definition: The date on which an event occurs.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: The category of a budget item.

name: BudgetSpent
definition: The amount of budget already spent.

name: BudgetRemaining
definition: The remaining budget amount.

name: BudgetAmount
definition: The total budget amount allocated.

name: BudgetEventStatus
definition: The status of the event associated with a budget.

name: AttendanceCount
definition: The number of members who attended an event.

name: IncomeAmount
definition: The amount of income received.

name: IncomeSource
definition: The source of income.

name: ZipCodeCity
definition: The city associated with a zip code.

name: ZipCodeCounty
definition: The county associated with a zip code.

name: ZipCodeState
definition: The state associated with a zip code.

name: ZipCodeShortState
definition: The abbreviated state code.

name: ZipCodeType
definition: The type of zip code area.

name: FullName
definition: The full name of a member, combining first and last name. Formula: CONCAT(MemberFirstName, ' ', MemberLastName). Inputs: MemberFirstName = member.first_name; MemberLastName = member.last_name

name: AverageExpenseCost
definition: The average cost of expenses. Formula: AVG(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: TotalExpenseCost
definition: The total cost of expenses. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: SpendToBudgetRatio
definition: The ratio of budget spent to budget amount. Formula: BudgetSpent / BudgetAmount. Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent; BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: BudgetExceeded
definition: Indicates if the budget was exceeded (remaining < 0). Formula: CASE WHEN BudgetRemaining < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: BudgetRemaining = budget.remaining

name: AttendanceCountPerEvent
definition: The number of members who attended a specific event. Formula: COUNT(AttendanceCount). Inputs: AttendanceCount = attendance.link_to_member

name: EventCost
definition: The total cost of expenses for an event. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: MemberExpenseTotal
definition: The total expenses incurred by a member. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: BudgetSpentPerEvent
definition: The total budget spent for a specific event. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent

name: BudgetAmountPerEvent
definition: The total budget amount allocated for a specific event. Formula: SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: IncomeTotal
definition: The total income received. Formula: SUM(IncomeAmount). Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount

name: ExpenseCount
definition: The number of expenses. Formula: COUNT(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: MemberCount
definition: The number of members. Formula: COUNT(MemberFirstName). Inputs: MemberFirstName = member.first_name

name: EventCount
definition: The number of events. Formula: COUNT(EventName). Inputs: EventName = event.event_name

name: CityCount
definition: The number of distinct cities. Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT ZipCodeCity). Inputs: ZipCodeCity = zip_code.city

name: EventStatus
definition: Answers questions about the status of events.

name: MemberPosition
definition: Answers questions about member positions.

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: Answers questions about t-shirt sizes.

name: MajorName
definition: Answers questions about academic majors.

name: EventType
definition: Answers questions about event types.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: Answers questions about budget categories.

name: ZipCodeState
definition: Answers questions about states.

name: ZipCodeCounty
definition: Answers questions about counties.
